name: I-7 Construct
description: The I-7 Construct was a form of modified Viper probe droid used during the Galactic Civil War. Droids of this kind was unarmed as it primarily filled a reconnaissance role. I-7 Construct droids were used by the Rak'qua on Station Gamma above Ord Mantell following the Battle of Yavin. In 1 ABY, a number of spacers who explored Station Gamma fought and destroyed multiple I-7 Construct droids.
